title: Generalize same-name semantic owner collision disclosure
outcome: Every semantic result honestly discloses loaded same-name physical owner collisions while preserving the approved assembly-name-keyed compilation model.
acceptance: Every semantic result whose loaded owner set contains non-paired same-name rows carries one stable collision note with the colliding physical paths.
The CLI changeset is already shipped separately before this work begins.
The disclosure has its own features entry, product regression coverage, and the required BuildInfo version bump.
docs/design.md records the two-layer physical-row versus assembly-name compilation identity model and Greg's approved rationale.
